content.text:
This Statement of Work covers a full bathroom refurbishment to the upstairs bathroom. The existing suite and fittings will be stripped out completely, and a new bath with overhead shower, basin and pedestal, and toilet will be installed in their place. Wall tiling will be carried out across approximately 14m², and the existing radiator will be swapped for a heated towel rail. Making good is included within the scope; decorating is not. The work will be carried out by a two-person crew over five days, with the aim of completing by 10th August. You will be supplying the bathroom suite and wall tiles directly; all other materials will be arranged as needed.

Please note that the condition of the soil stack cannot be confirmed until it is opened up during the strip-out. If any remedial work to the stack is found to be necessary, this will be treated as a provisional item and discussed with you before proceeding — it is not included in the current scope. This assumption should be reviewed and agreed before work begins.
